_comment: INSTRUCTIONS FOR USING THIS TEMPLATE (SINGLE-BATCH OR MULTI-BATCH)
_instructions: 2. Replace 'YOUR-TOPIC-ID' with your actual topic ID (must match folder name)
- Max per single grid: 4x4 (16 slots = 15 icons + 1 empty).
- Recommended single grid: 2x4 (8 slots = 7 icons + 1 empty) for best 512px sharpness.
- If > 15 icons: USE 'batches' array! (Batch 1: 4x4 or 2x4, Batch 2: 2x2 or 2x4).
- Avoid 1x4 or 4x1 grids because DALL-E distorts extreme aspect ratios.
name: YOUR-TOPIC-ID
description: Brief description of what these icons represent for your animation

icons.name: Display Name 1
icons.label: Short Label
icons.description: Clear description for ChatGPT (e.g., 'Web browser with globe icon')

generation.prompt:
Generate a 2x2 grid of 4 minimalist grayscale monochrome icons on transparent background (PNG). Icons are numbered top-left to bottom-right:

1. Display Name 1 (Web browser with globe icon)
2. Display Name 2 (Database cylinder)
3. Display Name 3 (Terminal prompt)
4. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]

Style requirements:
- Flat design, minimalist
- Black/gray colors only (grayscale/monochrome)
- Each icon same size and clearly distinct
- High contrast for visibility
- Transparent background (PNG)
- Grid layout: 2 rows × 2 columns
- Each icon should be recognizable and simple

batches.name: Core Systems (Batch 1/2)
batches.prompt: Generate a 2x4 grid of 8 minimalist grayscale monochrome icons... 1. Icon 1... 8. [EMPTY]...

batches.name: Tools & Apps (Batch 2/2)
batches.prompt: Generate a 2x2 grid of 4 minimalist grayscale monochrome icons... 1. Icon 8... 4. [EMPTY]...
